references.numbering_basis: Step 14.0 Gothic foliate ornament set — Reference A
references.category: Gothic geometric patterns and foliate motif plate
references.role: Symmetry, tracery, diaper repetition, crockets, cusps, interlacing panels and hierarchical ornament grammar for stone carving generators.
references.historical_style_uncertainty: Printed collage / pattern plate; source book, date and attributions unverified. Treat as a motif grammar board, not a single building survey.

references.numbering_basis: Step 14.0 Gothic foliate ornament set — Reference B
references.role: Anatomical density, antler-like recursive branching, cavities, skeletal/rib forms, bilateral symmetry and layered relief depth for grotesque stone ornament variation.
references.historical_style_uncertainty: Appears contemporary / speculative assemblage; author, medium and material unverified. Use for biomorphic morphology only — not as botanical vegetation or historical attribution.

references.numbering_basis: Step 14.0 Gothic foliate ornament set — Reference C
references.role: Integrated carved ornament emerging from host structure: ribs becoming foliage, perforated tracery, crocket curls, sculptural depth and stone materiality.
references.historical_style_uncertainty: Photographed interior support / canopy; building, date and restoration unknown. Primary evidence for architectural integration of foliate stone, not for literal plant growth.

references.numbering_basis: Step 14.0 Gothic foliate ornament set — Reference D
references.role: Mirrored recursion, scrollwork, dense branching, cusped terminals, perforated voids and controlled grotesque density for procedural ornament skeletons.
references.historical_style_uncertainty: High-contrast etched / stippled panels; source and date unidentified. Pattern logic reference — do not copy panels literally or treat as botanical vines.
